structured.label: Type 2 diabetes
structured.note: Diabetes duration under 10 years is not checked.

structured.label: HbA1c 7.5% to 11%
structured.note: The 3 months of stable oral glucose-lowering drugs is not checked.

structured.label: Currently on insulin
structured.note: Only the insulin product found in the Synthea sample (RxNorm 106892, the only insulin code in the sample) is recognised; any other insulin relies on the free text.

structured.label: Malignancy
structured.note: Coded: breast cancer, leukemia and metastatic prostate cancer found in the Synthea sample. Neoplasm of prostate (may be benign) and carcinoma in situ are left out; they and all other cancers rely on the free text.

structured.label: HbA1c below 10.0%
structured.note: The oral antidiabetic therapy requirement is not checked.

structured.label: eGFR below 45 mL/min/1.73m2
structured.note: Synthea records eGFR by the MDRD formula (LOINC 33914-3); the study does not name a formula.

structured.label: Taking metformin
structured.note: Only the metformin product found in the Synthea sample (RxNorm 860975, metformin ER 500 mg, the only metformin code in the sample) is recognised; other metformin products rely on the free text; the DPP-4 inhibitor and dose stability are not checked.

structured.label: HbA1c 7.0% or higher
structured.note: Interpreted from garbled source text ("HbA1c ≤ 7.0% ≤ HbA1c < 10%") as 7.0% to below 10%.

structured.label: BMI 18.5 to 40 kg/m2
structured.note: Interpreted from garbled source text ("BMI ≤ 18.5 kg/m2 ≤ 40 kg/m2") as 18.5 to 40 kg/m2.

structured.label: eGFR below 45 mL/min/1.73m2
structured.note: The study uses CKD-EPI; Synthea records eGFR by the MDRD formula (LOINC 33914-3).

structured.label: Receiving insulin
structured.note: Only the insulin product found in the Synthea sample (RxNorm 106892) is recognised; other drug classes rely on the free text.

structured.label: HbA1c 7.5% to 10%
structured.note: The result must be from screening or the 30 days before it.

structured.label: Use of insulin
structured.note: Only the insulin product found in the Synthea sample (RxNorm 106892) is recognised; GLP-1 receptor agonists rely on the free text.

structured.label: eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73m2
structured.note: Synthea records eGFR by the MDRD formula (LOINC 33914-3); the study does not name a formula.
